description: Surface an internal date inconsistency (a due-date pair that contradicts itself across a checklist and its governing clause) for review rather than silently trusting either date.

Elevate a missing-supporting-evidence item to a missed-deadline signal once at least two consecutive compliance reports have filed with the same evidence still missing, indicating the gap has persisted across a full reporting cycle rather than being newly discovered.
Flag an ambiguous-response signal when a clarification thread's content-level review status is explicitly recorded as unresolved (a reply that does not confirm the specific fact asked about).
